title: varg how to · I know how

shots.subject: agent
shots.camera: WS, front, high, slow push in
shots.picture: The loft at night. Rain on the tall windows. The agent sits still in the leather armchair under the work lamp; the operator works at the CRT console on the left.
shots.action: Rain runs down the tall windows. The porcelain android sits motionless in the oxblood leather armchair, eyes closed, a cable running from the back of its head across the floor to the console. At the console on the left the woman types, lit by the amber screens. The camera pushes in slowly.

shots.subject: keys
shots.picture: Her hands on the mechanical keyboard, amber glow on the fingers.
shots.action: Close-up of the woman's hands typing fast on a heavy mechanical keyboard, amber monitor light on her fingers; the last key is struck firmly.

shots.subject: screen
shots.picture: The terminal. She types: how to make a music video. The real varg how to answer appears: best match, the varg-music-video skill. LOAD.
shots.overlay: terminal UI with the real /how-to/api/search output

shots.subject: agent
shots.picture: The agent, eyes closed. Amber light scans over the porcelain face.
shots.action: The porcelain android's face, eyes closed, completely still; a band of amber light sweeps over the porcelain from left to right as the load begins.

shots.subject: screen
shots.picture: The skill streams in: flashes of real how-to preview clips and the steps (concept, character, beat grid, stills, Seedance, lip-sync), intercut with flickers of the agent's closed eyes.
shots.overlay: loading montage of real s3.varg.ai/how-to previews

shots.subject: agent
shots.picture: The eyes open. An ember glint in the dark glass.
shots.action: Extreme close-up of the porcelain android's eyes: the porcelain eyelids open slowly, revealing eyes of dark glass with a small ember-orange glint. It does not blink.
shots.line: Agent: I know how to make a music video.

shots.subject: operator
shots.picture: The operator at the console turns from the screens to the agent, half smile.
shots.action: The woman at the console turns her head from the screens toward the android, takes off one side of her headset, and gives a small dry half smile.

shots.subject: agent
shots.picture: Hard cut to white. An infinite white void; the agent stands alone, small in the centre.
shots.action: An infinite white void with soft shadowless light. The porcelain android stands alone in the centre, small in the frame, its faint reflection on the white floor. The camera cranes down slowly.

shots.subject: agent
shots.picture: The agent raises its hand; around it a rainy neon street assembles out of the white.
shots.action: The porcelain android raises its right hand calmly. Around it the white void turns into a wet night street: walls rise from the floor, red and amber neon lights switch on one by one, rain starts to fall.

shots.subject: singer
shots.picture: The music video it made: the singer in a red vinyl coat walks toward us through the rain under red neon.
shots.action: Music video shot: the singer in the glossy red vinyl coat walks toward the camera down the wet street in the rain, under red and amber neon, steam rising, her wet black bob swinging; she stops and looks straight into the lens on the beat.

shots.subject: operator
shots.picture: Back in the loft. The operator, impressed, eyebrows up; she turns back to the keys.
shots.action: Close-up of the woman at the console, amber light on her glasses; she raises her eyebrows, impressed, and leans back toward the keyboard.

shots.subject: screen
shots.picture: The catalog flicks past: real how-to titles and skill cards accelerating into a blur.
shots.overlay: catalog flick of real varg.ai/how-to titles

shots.subject: agent
shots.picture: The agent turns its head and looks straight into the lens.
shots.action: Close-up: the porcelain android slowly turns its head from the woman to look straight into the lens, eyes of dark glass with the ember glint; perfectly calm.

shots.subject: screen
shots.picture: varg how to. Teach your agent to make any video. Skills for Claude Code, Codex and Grok. varg.ai/how-to
